<entry id="M00251">
<head-word>מָדַד</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to stretch</italic>,] 
<italic>to measure</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 149
<sup>b</sup> sq. (play on מ̇ד̇ה̇ב̇ה, Is. XIV, 4) the nation that said מְ֗ד̇וד̇, וה̇ב̇א measure (the area of thy land) and bring (tribute); Lev. R. s. 15, end (Ar.: מוֹד והָבָה measure and give). Erub. V, 4 אין מוֹדְדִין וכ' Sabbath distances must be measured only with a rope of &c. Ib. 5 אין מודדין אלא מן המומחה the measuring must be done only by the best experts. Y. Succ. I, 51
<sup>d</sup> אם יָמוֹד מן וכ' if he measures from &c. Maas. Sh. V, 9 עשור שאני עתיד לָמֹוֹד one tenth (as tithe) which I shall measure off (when I come home); a. fr.—Sot. I, 7 במדה שאדם מוֹדֵד בה מוֹדְדִין לו the measure with which man measures will be measured out to him, i.e. as man deals, he will be dealt with, v. אַכְרַעְתָּא; Tosef. ib. III, 1 מ' בסאה he measured by the S’ah (committed great wrong). Ber. IX, 5, v. next w.—Ib. 30
<sup>b</sup> לעולם יָמוֹד אדם וכ' man must always measure himself (examine the disposition of his mind; cmp. אָמַד), if he feels that he can direct his mind, let him pray, if not &c.</notes></sense></senses>

<entry id="M00252">
<head-word>מִדָּה</head-word>
<head-word>מִידָּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>dimension, measure, proportion</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 150
<sup>a</sup> (play on מ̇ד̇ה̇ב̇ה, v. preced.) מ̇אד̇ מ̇אד̇ ה̇ב̇א בלא מ̇' bring much, very much, without measure. Peah VIII, 6 מ' זו this proportion. Gen. R. s. 64; Esth. R. introd. (ref. to מנדה, Ezra IV, 13) זו מִדַּת הארץ that is the tax from the land as measured, i.e. the (Roman) land-tax. B. Bath. VII, 3 מ' בחבל וכ' I sell thee exact land-measure by the rope. Ib. 128
<sup>a</sup> מִדַּת ארכו the length-measure of the cloak. Ib. מדת משקלותיו the measure of its (the gold-bar’s) weights, i.e. an estimate as to how many coins of a certain weight can be obtained from it. Ḥag. 12
<sup>a</sup> מדת יום ומ' לילה the combined length of day and night. Yeb. 76
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to I Sam. XVII, 38) מַדָּיו כמִדָּתוֹ his (Saul’s) garments such as fitted his stature. Mikv. X, 5; Ḥull. 73
<sup>a</sup> עד מקום (ה)מ' as far as the designed length of the handle (excluding the portion which it is intended to cut off).—Kidd. 42
<sup>b</sup>; B. Mets. 56
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. דבר שבמ' ושבמשקל וכ' objects which are sold by measure, by weight or by the piece. B. Bath. 89
<sup>b</sup> לעולם … מ' חסירה וכ' one must never keep in one’s house too small or too large a measure (smaller or larger than the legal size); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. מִדּוֹת, מִידּוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. 88
<sup>b</sup> עונשן של מ' the divine punishment for fraudulent measures. Tosef. B. Mets. VI, 14 לא היו ממונין … אלא על המ' they (the 
<italic>agoranomoi</italic> in Jerusalem) were appointed not for the regulation of market prices but for the superintendence of the measures; B. Bath. 89
<sup>a</sup>, v. אֲגַרְדְּמִיס; a. fr.—Men. 18

<notes> 89
<sup>a</sup> (play on הא̇מ̇נ̇ם א̇ל̇ם̇, Ps. LVIII, 2) מה א̇ומ̇נ̇תו … כא̇ל̇ם̇ which is the best policy for man in this world? Let him act as if he were mute (keep silence). B. Mets. 63
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. מה לו הן מה לי דמיהן what are they to me and what their equivalent, i.e. what difference does it make whether the purchased objects or their equivalent be delivered?; Y. Yoma V, 43
<sup>a</sup> bot. מה ביניהן ומה בין דמיהן. B. Bath. 32
<sup>b</sup>; 31
<sup>a</sup> מה (לי) לו לשקר what motive could he have to tell a lie? Ib., a. e. מה לי לשקר במקום עדים וכ' we do not apply the principle that we believe a defendant because he has no motive to lie, where witnesses are on hand; a. v. fr.—מה … אף what …?, even so, i.e. 
<italic>as … so</italic>. Gitt. 23
<sup>b</sup> מה אתם … אף וכ' as 
<italic>you</italic> (Num. XVIII, 28) refers to Israelites, so must your delegate be an Israelite. Sabb. 133
<sup>b</sup> מה הוא … אף וכ' as He is gracious and merciful, so be thou &c.; a. fr.—מה … לא כל שכן, v. כָּל.—מה … אינו דין, v. דִּין II.—מה ל־ … שכן … תאמר what has this to do with …? In this case …, whereas &c., i.e. 
<italic>it is different with</italic> … 
<italic>because</italic> &c. Kidd. 4
<sup>b</sup> מה ליבמה שכן … תאמר וכ' the case of a Y’bamah is different, because she can neither be acquired by means of a document, whereas this (an ordinary woman) &c.; a. fr.—מָה נַפְשְׁךָ (in Babli mostly: מִמָּה נפשך; abbr. ממ"נ) whatever be thy opinion (from whatever opinion thou start), i.e. 
<italic>whichever side you take, at all events</italic>. Y. Ber. I, 2
<sup>b</sup> מ' נ' אם וכ' at all events (he has offended); if it was day-time when the first stars (on Friday evening) were visible, it was day-time when the first stars (on Sabbath evening) were visible &c.; Sabb. 35
<sup>b</sup> חייכ חטאת ממ"נ must bring a sin-offering at all events (whether you consider twilight a part of the day or a part of the night). Ib. 34
<sup>a</sup> (in Chald. dict.) מה נפשך אי וכ' whichever side you take, if twilight is day &c. Erub. 10
<sup>a</sup> גדולה … למה לי ממ"נ אי וכ' what reason was there for saying ‘large …’? In either case (it is incorrect), if it be to permit the use of the larger court &c. Ḥull. 29
<sup>a</sup> ממ"נ אי מחצה וכ' in either case (the slaughtering is ritually correct); if you adopt the opinion that an exact half is to be considered as if it were the larger portion &c.; a. v. fr.—Ib. 78
<sup>b</sup> מה אם נפשך, v. נֶפֶשׁ.—בַּמֶּה a) 
<italic>wherewith?</italic> B. Bath. 10
<sup>b</sup> במה תרום וכ' whereby can the horn of Israel be lifted up? Sabb. II, 1; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>in what case?</italic> במה דברים אמורים (abbr. בד"א), v. אָמַר I.—לָמָּה 
<italic>wherefore?</italic> Ber. 3
<sup>a</sup> תחלת … סימנא למה לי what need is there for a sign for the beginning of the first watch? M. Kat. 28
<sup>a</sup> ל' נסמכה וכ' why is the account of the death of Miriam attached to &c.?; a. fr.—לַמֶּה 
<italic>to what?, whereto?</italic> Kidd. 40
<sup>b</sup> ל' צדיקים נמשלים what are the righteous to be compared to?—ל' הדבר דומה, v. דָּמָה; a. fr.—V. לָמָה.</notes></sense>
